messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] prod-euc1 ingress 5xx spike (ALB targetgroup unhealthy) - 1827755555

oncall-jordan: acknowledged. I'm on it, paging SRE rotation now.

sre-amy: I'm awake, joining. seeing ~18% 5xx on ingress for prod-euc1 across multiple services. metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/svc-ingress?panel=5

infra-ops: Confirming ALB target-group in eu-central-1b is reporting unhealthy targets (ENI detach events). AWS console shows increased connection resets to envoy nodes in az-b.

oncall-jordan: quick triage: is this an ALB <-> ENI level networking issue or Envoy crashloop? any pod restarts?

sre-amy: pods stable, no OOMs. envoy logs show repeated `HTTP/1.1 504 upstream reset` and `connection reset by peer` from the local ENI. sample curl to a backend from envoy pod: ```bash
kubectl exec -n ingress svc/envoy-ingress -c envoy -- curl -sv http://10.2.45.23/health
* About to connect() to 10.2.45.23 port 80 (#0)
* connected to 10.2.45.23 (10.2.45.23) port 80
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: 10.2.45.23
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```

infra-ops: AWS NLB/ENI logs show spike in connection resets from hypervisor level in az-b. Also seeing EC2 host network interface flaps in that AZ. AWS is showing degraded network performance for eu-central-1b.

eng-lead-maya: customer impact? which routes and customers affected?

oncall-jordan: initial impact estimate: 15-25% increase in 5xx for end-user API traffic in eu-central-1 region. Traffic to global endpoints is partially routed to eu-central, so customers with endpoints pinned to eu-central see higher error rates. CS, FYI.

customer-success-bob: getting inbound tickets from three customers in EU complaining about slow/failing responses. I'll notify them that we're actively investigating and that we may route traffic to eu-west-1 as mitigation.

sre-amy: short-term mitigations: 1) fail traffic from eu-central-1b to other healthy AZs in same region by changing ALB routing -> but ALB still uses ENIs in that AZ; 2) adjust smart-routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for non-data-residency customers; 3) increase envoys in eu-central-1a/c to absorb load.

oncall-jordan: doing (3) now: scaling ingress replicas in euc1: ```bash
kubectl -n ingress scale deploy/envoy-ingress --replicas=12 --context=prod-euc1
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for envoy-ingress scale - rollout id 2026-03-15T02:05Z

infra-ops: I've increased ALB deregistration timeout so existing connections can drain: changed from 300s -> 600s for tg-prod-euc1. Also temporarily set target weighting to reduce traffic to az-b targets.

sre-amy: applying smart-route weight change for non-residency customers: shifting 40% of eu-central traffic to eu-west until AWS confirms AZ stability.

eng-lead-maya: can we do a DNS-level emergency TTL change to steer more traffic off eu-central for global endpoints?

infra-ops: TTL is 60s for global api domain, we can update routing policy in the control plane to prefer eu-west for the next 15 minutes. Doing it now.

sre-amy: temporary traffic steering in the control plane applied. Observability: error rate dropped from 18% -> 7% after shift. latency slightly increased for those routed cross-region but acceptable.

customer-success-bob: telling customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA. please flag any customers with strict residency requirements before we move more traffic.

oncall-jordan: AWS support case opened (case 987654321) for eu-central-1 network degradation. They report investigation ongoing, possible host-level networking issue isolated to az-b.

infra-ops: to reduce blast radius we'll cordon problematic nodes in az-b and shift ALB target registrations out of that AZ: ```bash
aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --instance-id i-0abcd1234 --no-source-dest-check
# (cordon nodes via autoscaling lifecycle, then update targetgroup weights)
```

sre-amy: executed cordon + drained 3 nodes in az-b. New pods scheduled in az-a/c. Monitoring healthchecks.

oncall-jordan: quick customer-impact summary for status page: "Partial service disruptions from 02:05-02:55 UTC impacting a subset of EU customers due to network degradation in eu-central-1 AZ. Mitigation: traffic steered to eu-west-1 and unaffected AZs. Working with cloud provider for root cause." Approving post an update.

eng-lead-maya: good. also track any config changes we made (deregistration timeout, target weights, control-plane routing weights, scale events) for the postmortem.

deploy-bot: envoy-ingress scaled to 12 replicas - success.

infra-ops: AWS reports host flaps resolved for some hosts; there are still elevated error rates from older ENIs. They recommend redeploying troubled hosts.

sre-amy: rolling restart of envoy pods in eu-central-1 to rebind ENIs where needed: ```bash
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/envoy-ingress --context=prod-euc1
```

oncall-jordan: monitoring after restart. metrics trending back to baseline. 5xx now at ~2.3% region-wide, eu-central-1 at 4.5% but falling.

customer-success-bob: customers updated — two major customers confirmed it's back to normal for them.

infra-ops: reverted the ALB deregistration timeout back to 300s. Kept a small traffic preference to eu-west for 10 more minutes as a precaution; will remove after confirmation.

sre-amy: preparing incident page and assigning postmortem. Notes: root cause likely transient host-level network degradation in eu-central-1b causing ENI connection resets -> ALB targetgroup health flaps -> envoy upstream resets -> 5xx spike. Mitigations used: scale up ingress, cordon+drain nodes, adjust ALB target weights, temporary cross-region routing, rolling restart of envoy pods, adjust deregistration timeout.

oncall-jordan: handing incident to oncall-amy for postmortem follow-up and long-term remediation. Handoff checklist: summary, timeline, configs changed, customer impact, AWS case id 987654321.

sre-amy: acknowledged handoff. I'll own the postmortem and action items: 1) improve ALB-target health metrics alerts, 2) add ENI-level network-flap detector, 3) run chaos tests for AZ-level flaps, 4) review control-plane routing escalation.

eng-lead-maya: assign owners and due dates in JIRA, please.

customer-success-bob: closing customer comms loop once postmortem link available.

oncall-jordan: incident declared resolved at 1827756355 - restoring normal routing. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
